verse.verse_2: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, demand full measure,
verse.verse_3: And when they have to give by measure or weight to men, give less than due.
verse.verse_4: Do they not think that they will be resurrected,
verse.verse_6: The Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of all that exists
verse.verse_7: Nay! Truly, the Record of the wicked is in Sijjin.
verse.verse_8: And what will make you know what Sijjin is
verse.verse_10: Woe, that Day, to those who deny.
verse.verse_11: Those who deny the Day of Recompense.
verse.verse_12: And none can deny it except every transgressor beyond bounds, the sinner!
verse.verse_13: When Our Ayat are recited to him, he says: "Tales of the ancients!"
verse.verse_14: Nay! But on their hearts is the Ran (covering) which they used to earn.
verse.verse_15: Nay! Surely, they will be veiled from seeing their Lord that Day.
verse.verse_16: Then verily, they will indeed enter the burning flame of Hell.
verse.verse_17: Then, it will be said to them: "This is what you used to deny!"
verse.verse_18: Nay! Verily, the Record of Al-Abrar (the righteous believers) is (preserved) in `Illiyyin.
verse.verse_19: And what will make you know what `Illiyyin is
verse.verse_21: To which bear witness those nearest.
verse.verse_22: Verily, Al-Abrar (the righteous believers) will be in Delight.
verse.verse_24: You will recognize in their faces the brightness of delight.
verse.verse_25: They will be given to drink of pure sealed Rahiq.
verse.verse_26: Sealed with musk, and for this let those strive who want to strive.
verse.verse_27: It will be mixed with Tasnim:
verse.verse_28: A spring whereof drink those nearest to Allah.
verse.verse_29: Verily, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
verse.verse_30: And, whenever they passed by them, used to wink one to another.
verse.verse_31: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;
verse.verse_32: And when they saw them, they said: "Verily, these have indeed gone astray!"
verse.verse_33: But they were not sent as watchers over them.
verse.verse_34: But this Day those who believe will laugh at the disbelievers
verse.verse_36: Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do
